propositions: KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS contains four ghost rows (_rebar_env, _env_int, _str_pref, _int_pref) with no corresponding function definitions under src/rebar, creating a fail-open validation gap.
Ghost rows exempted unowned environment reads from the config-ownership gate by name match alone, allowing env reads that should be flagged to pass silently.
A ghost row signals a silently-dropped rename (demonstrated by _str_pref -> _gate_str_pref, which lost REBAR_GATE_REF/REBAR_GATE_SOURCE keys for three days).
The held-out ownership test was load-bearing on dict insertion order and a ghost row's position, failing RED when the ghosts were removed.
Validation must be root-independent (against DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT, not caller's root) to avoid false positives in synthetic test trees where all rows appear stale.
